name: OpenRestoPro ERP – Billing POS
tagline: Billing, Orders & Accounts for Restaurants, Cake Shops & Cafés • Open Source
description: OpenRestoPro ERP is the Android app for the open-source OpenRestoPro ERP website: a complete billing and back-office system for restaurants, cake shops, sweet shops, cafés, hotels and fast-food counters. The app connects to your own OpenRestoPro ERP server, so your business data stays on your server. Take counter, takeaway, dine-in (with KOT), delivery and advance/custom orders, pick cake sizes in kg or pound, add GST or simple bills, print on a Bluetooth thermal printer and share the bill on WhatsApp. Track expenses and vendor khata, mark staff attendance and get salary worked out automatically, and see your profit in dashboards, a master ledger and PDF/Excel reports. Owner, manager and cashier logins. Free with a small banner ad; a one-time Pro purchase removes ads.
features: Fast counter billing (POS): counter, takeaway, dine-in with KOT, delivery and advance / custom orders
Cake sizes in kg or pound, custom items for special orders with advance paid and balance due
GST billing (inclusive or exclusive, CGST/SGST) or simple bills without GST
Print receipts and kitchen tickets on a Bluetooth thermal printer (58 / 80 mm), share bills as PDF or link on WhatsApp
Dashboard with today's collection, month sales, expenses, profit and dues
Day-end, item-wise sales, sales by hour, GST summary, monthly / yearly reports — PDF and Excel
Expenses with bill photos and vendor khata with running balance
Staff attendance in one tap with automatic salary, advances, bonus and deductions
Master ledger with cash, bank / UPI and online balances
Owner, manager and cashier roles — cashiers only see the counter
Works with your own self-hosted OpenRestoPro ERP website (open source, MIT licence)
Free with a small banner ad — one-time Pro purchase removes ads (no subscription)

notes: Free version with a small banner ad (never on the billing screen)
Pro: one-time purchase that removes ads
Point of sale: counter, takeaway, dine-in with KOT, delivery and advance orders
Bluetooth thermal printing and WhatsApp bill sharing
Cake sizes in kg / pound, custom items, GST or simple billing
